It's mainly my left big toe and both of my hips and knees that are bothering me. This has been getting worse and worse for several years now.
I see. Is the stiffness and pain worse when you first wake up in the morning, or does it get worse throughout the day as you move around?
It’s actually not too bad when I first wake up. The pain really starts to act up once I get moving and gets much worse the more active I am during the day.

Have you noticed any swelling, redness, or a grinding sensation when moving those joints? I am also going to order some imaging to get a better look at the joint spaces.
